name: Pradhan Mantri Janjatiya Vikas Mission (PMJVM)
benefit: - **Livelihood Support:** Provides support for income generation through value addition and processing of Minor Forest Produce.  - **Formation of SHGs and VDVKs:** Supports creation of Van Dhan Self Help Groups (up to 20 members) and Van Dhan Vikas Kendras (around 300 members).  - **Infrastructure Support:** Provides assistance for setting up processing units, storage facilities, and haat bazaars.
_eligibility_text: - **MSP Support:** Fixation and procurement of non-nationalised, non-timber Minor Forest Produce (MFPs) to ensure a fair price to tribal gatherers. - **Infrastructure Development:** Creation and development of Haat Bazars, storage godowns, and other facilities, including special projects for tribal trade and storage. - **Value Addition:** Support for processing and value addition to various MFPs, non-MFPs, and other tribal produce/products to enhance income. - **Enterprise Creation:** Establishment of Van Dhan Vikas Kendras (VDVKs) and Van Dhan Producer Enterprises (VDPEs) for organised tribal business activities. - **Marketing Support:** Facilitation of sale and purchase of products made by VDVKs/VDPEs and other tribal products such as handloom and handicrafts. - **Branding & Promotion:** Advertisement, branding, and promotion of tribal products through participation in festivals, exhibitions, tribal artisan melas, and Mahotsavas. - **Skill & Entrepreneurship Development:** Training and capacity building for tribal beneficiaries to develop skills and entrepreneurial capabilities. - **Geo-Tagging of Assets:** Geo-tagging of VDVKs, VDPEs, and other assets created under the scheme for better monitoring and tracking. - **Geographical Indication Support:** Promotion and support for Geographical Indication (GI) tagging of tribal produce/products. - **IT & E-Commerce Development:** Building and upgradation of IT infrastructure, e-commerce platforms, and digitisation of operations. - **Beneficiary Survey:** Conducting surveys for the identification, assessment, and monitoring of beneficiaries. - **Research & Development:** Support for research and development activities to improve tribal products and processes.
